source_scope_conventions.Suzuki_type: The source defines Suzuki type as simple and explicitly excludes Sz(2); this convention governs Suzuki groups in the prescribed residues.

prior_review_hold.reason: Canonical existence and a false global classification did not dispose of local conditional extension necessity. This edition imports the two subsequently accepted necessity proofs.
